messages.subject: Global Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ventus International Team,

Your specialist recruitment work across renewable energy and international energy markets makes this a focused introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with a portfolio spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, external affairs, strategic partnerships and stakeholder governance around major industrial renewable-energy investment.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where energy transition, institutional engagement and responsible development intersect. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments across the GCC and wider global markets.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
